agent_final_answer:
Side-by-side comparison of the **2003 Acura CL (3.2L Coupe)** and the **2022 Acura ILX (Sedan)** based on data from Cars.com:

---

### **Overview & Pricing**
* **Starting MSRP:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** $28,200
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** $27,300
* **Body Style:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 2-Door Coupe
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 4-Door Sedan
* **Consumer Rating:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 4.6 / 5.0
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 5.0 / 5.0
* **Seating Capacity:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 4 passengers
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 5 passengers

---

### **Engine & Performance**
* **Engine Type:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 3.2L Gas V6 (196 cu. in.)
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 2.4L Premium Unleaded I-4 (144 cu. in.)
* **Horsepower:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 225 hp @ 5,600 RPM
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 201 hp @ 6,800 RPM
* **Torque:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 216 lb-ft @ 4,700 RPM
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 180 lb-ft @ 3,600 RPM
* **Transmission:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 5-Speed Automatic with Dual Shift Mode
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 8-Speed Dual-Clutch Automatic with Dual Shift Mode
* **Drivetrain:** Front-Wheel Drive on both models

---

### **Fuel Economy & Capacity**
* **Fuel Economy:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 20 City / 29 Hwy MPG
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 24 City / 34 Hwy MPG (28 MPG combined)
* **Fuel Tank Capacity:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** Approx. 17.0 gallons
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** Approx. 13.2 gallons

---

### **Dimensions & Weight**
* **Overall Length:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 192.0 in.
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 182.2 in.
* **Overall Width:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 69.2 in.
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 70.6 in.
* **Overall Height:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 53.3 in.
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 55.6 in.
* **Wheelbase:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 106.9 in.
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 105.1 in.
* **Curb Weight:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 3,470 lbs.
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 3,095 lbs.
* **Cargo / Trunk Volume:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 13.6 cu. ft. (~14 cu. ft.)
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 12.4 cu. ft. (~12 cu. ft.)
* **Passenger Volume:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 90.2 cu. ft.
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 89.3 cu. ft.

---

### **Wheels, Tires & Chassis**
* **Wheels:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** 16" x 6.5" aluminum
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** 17" x 7.0" aluminum
* **Tires:** 
  * **2003 Acura CL:** P205/60VR16 (includes compact spare)
  * **2022 Acura ILX:** P215/45VR17
* **Front Suspension:** Double-Wishbone Independent (CL) vs. Strut (ILX)
* **Rear Suspension:** Double-Wishbone Independent (CL) vs. Multi-Link (ILX)
* **Brakes:** 4-Wheel disc brakes with ABS on both models

---

### **Safety & Technology Features**
* **Stability Control:** Not standard on CL; Standard on ILX
* **Backup Camera:** Not available on 2003 CL; Standard on 2022 ILX
* **Automatic Emergency Braking:** Not available on 2003 CL; Standard on 2022 ILX
* **Lane Departure Warning:** Not available on 2003 CL; Standard on 2022 ILX
* **Bluetooth® Connectivity:** Not available on 2003 CL; Standard on 2022 ILX

---

### **Warranty**
* **Basic Warranty:** 4 years / 50,000 miles for both models
